hotels.title: Central Vietnam Private Pool Villas with Two Rounds of Golf, Daily Breakfast & Two Lunches or Dinners
hotels.description: World-class golf meets five-star luxury at this exclusive stay in the heart of Vietnam. Check into the stunning Banyan Tree Lang Co for pool villa luxury - tucked in a white-sand bay between Hue, Da Nang and Hoi An - and enjoy two rounds of golf at one of the country's finest courses. Relax, indulge and navigate the fairways of Laguna Golf Lang Co, an 18-hole championship course designed by Sir Nick Faldo, where dramatic mountain backdrops meet the sparkling waters of Lang Co Bay. When you're off the course, the resort has plenty to offer - unwind at the dreamy spa, join a Vietnamese cooking class or greet the morning with sunrise yoga on the beach.
